## Advanced topics {#sec-pri-5}

[**Contents of "Advanced Topics" section**]{#sec-pri-5-contents}

This section builds on the basics of DOE described in the preceding sections by adding brief or survey descriptions of a selection of useful techniques. Subjects covered are:

1. [When classical designs don't work](#sec-pri-51)
2. [Computer-aided designs](#sec-pri-52)
   1. [D-Optimal designs](#sec-pri-521)
   2. [Repairing a design](#sec-pri-522)
3. [How do you optimize a process?](#sec-pri-53)
   1. [Single response case](#sec-pri-531)
      - [Path of steepest ascent](#sec-pri-5311)
      - [Confidence region for search path](#sec-pri-5312)
      - [Choosing the step length](#sec-pri-5313)
      - [Optimization when there is adequate quadratic fit](#sec-pri-5314)
      - [Effect of sampling error on optimal solution](#sec-pri-5315)
      - [Optimization subject to experimental region constraints](#sec-pri-5316)
   2. [Multiple response case](#sec-pri-532)
      - [Path of steepest ascent](#sec-pri-5321)
      - [The desirability function approach](#sec-pri-5322)
      - [The mathematical programming approach](#sec-pri-5323)
4. [What is a mixture design?](#sec-pri-54)
   1. [Mixture screening designs](#sec-pri-541)
   2. [Simplex-lattice designs](#sec-pri-542)
   3. [Simplex-centroid designs](#sec-pri-543)
   4. [Constrained mixture designs](#sec-pri-544)
   5. [Treating mixture and process variables together](#sec-pri-545)
5. [How can I account for nested variation (restricted randomization)?](#sec-pri-55)
6. [What are Taguchi designs?](#sec-pri-56)
7. [What are John's 3/4 fractional factorial designs?](#sec-pri-57)
